documentation.content:
One or more held symbols have been in FC-029 R3 drawdown pause for >= the alert threshold (default 7 trading days). The bot is not writing covered calls on them, so that capital is idle.

Precedent: AMZN's 62-day implicit pause (Feb-Apr 2026) cost an estimated $1,500-3,000 in foregone premium.

Also matches DRAWDOWN_PAUSE_ALERT_CHECK_FAILED - the daily check could not evaluate pause state. Treat that as 'unknown', not 'all clear'.

NOTE: the filter deliberately does NOT constrain severity. Cloud Run captures the app's stderr as plain text with EMPTY severity, so a severity>=WARNING clause matches nothing (verified by fire drill 2026-07-18). Payload shape is matched both ways so structured logging can be adopted later without breaking the alert.

Runbook: deploy/monitoring/drawdown_pause_alert.md
